description: Plugin assignments for sync-to-plugin.sh. Maps each item in the extracted prompts/ output to its target plugin subdirectory.

ag-core.description: Product-agnostic LLM/agentic tooling — memory, reflection, interviews, plan review/verify

ag-prodeng.description: Product-engineering tooling across ag-charts/ag-grid/ag-studio — engineering, PM, release, prompt/rulesync, shared docs-review methodology

ag-charts.description: AG Charts product-specific — chart docs config, series performance, visual QA, release tooling, SonarCloud

notes.localItems: The following items currently in .rulesync/ (local tier) stay local and are NOT in any plugin: skills[technology-stack]. These appear alongside plugin skills as bare /name (no namespace conflict because plugin items use /ag-*:name).
notes.directCommits: The 6 agents in ag-charts (data-viz-designer, example-tester, previs-evaluator, technical-research-analyst, test-writer, visual-qa), all ag-charts skills, all ag-charts commands (prepare-release-notes, previs, release-blog-writer, release-options-review), and the ag-prodeng docs-review + release-docs-review skills (inverted from the old ag-charts docs-review + release-docs-review wrappers) are direct commits to ag-dev-prompts.
notes.excludedFromPlugin: hooks/, .mcp.json, .claude-settings.json, .cursor-worktrees.json are excluded (conflict with project settings when loaded as plugin).
notes.beta: Version 0.5.0-beta.5 inverts the docs-review partial pattern: generic methodology now lives in plugins/ag-prodeng/skills/{docs-review,release-docs-review}/SKILL.md with product configs under product subfolders (e.g. ag-charts/config.md). The old ag-charts docs-review + release-docs-review wrappers and the _docs-review-core.md / _release-docs-review-core.md partials are removed. Four AG-Charts-specific artefacts moved from ag-prodeng to ag-charts: sonar-fix (skill), prepare-release-notes, release-blog-writer, release-options-review (commands). Also fixes leaked .rulesync/ path references across the remaining skills. Beta tag retained until every downstream repo has migrated.
